utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane—I'm still waiting on the confirmed start time and the simple repair list for Saturday morning. Once Tess has that, I can tell folks exactly what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Eli—I’ll stick to the sign-up table for the first hour and won’t promise folks details until Tess confirms the start time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane—that keeps things orderly. Once Tess confirms the time and list, I’ll pass it along so the sign-up table has the same clear information.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, I’m fitting repair drive shifts around school drop-off and pickup—do you know anyone free in those windows so I can keep it straight with Opal’s sign-up list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only half-caught the details, Faye, but Leo said they mainly need folks with screwdrivers or pliers for an hour Saturday. I don’t know the start time yet—Opal was checking with you on that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—that helps; I’ll pencil in one-hour tool slots for Saturday but hold the start time until Opal confirms, so I don’t double-book anyone around drop-off or pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We start Saturday at 9 by the tool bins. Bring screwdrivers or pliers if you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Leo—Saturday at 9 by the tool bins it is. I’ll bring my toolbox, spare drill set, and make sure there are screwdrivers and pliers in there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Gus. Sam’s clipboard has the crew list, and the blue folder has the forms if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m helping with the repair drive by sorting donated tools and labeling anything dull or missing parts, so I’ll bring my clipboard and labels on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’ll be a big help. One update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so bring your clipboard and labels there instead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the update, Rosa — I’ll bring my clipboard and labels to the community center on Sunday and sort the tools there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Uli, I’m checking the repair drive details before I act—do you know if Jules is still the best contact for the latest setup and volunteer plan?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Jules is still the safest person to check with for the setup plan, Hana. I’m mostly keeping to the quiet sign-up side, but I can pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli—that helps. I’ll check with Jules for the confirmed setup, and if you hear any sign-up changes, please pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, quick update from Tess: Saturday morning is still the word, and folks are already bringing lamps, bikes, and even a wobbly chair—could you help steer any spare tools or parts that way?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Quinn—I’ll pull the spare tools and parts aside for Saturday morning, with extra attention to lamp bits, bike-chain supplies, and anything for wobbly chairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Cleo—thank you! I’ll keep nudging folks your way and make sure everyone hears Saturday morning, especially anyone with bike chains or wobbly chair troubles.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, Rey’s still gathering the repair list, so don’t announce a supply collector yet. Once he confirms priorities and volunteers, can you help pick one clear person?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, once Rey gives us the priorities and who’s available, I’ll help choose one clear collector. Until then, I won’t put out any supply request.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—hold off until Rey sends the list, and I’ll check back with him today. Once we have names and priorities, I’ll bring them to you so we can choose the collector.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m still out asking around—have you heard a confirmed time for the repair drive or seen any repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I haven’t seen a confirmed list or time yet, Ira. Before we spread anything, can you confirm whether Rey’s list is in and who’s actually collecting supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t confirmed Rey’s list yet, and so far I’ve only heard Sam’s helping sort tools and track parts; I’ll keep asking and won’t spread anything until I know who’s collecting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, I’ve heard the repair drive is Saturday morning, but Tess is still confirming the exact start time and repair list, so I’ll pass along the clear details once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik—that helps. Once Tess confirms the start time and repair list, can you send them my way so I can update Dane at the sign-up table and the small-appliance crews?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Jules—I’ll send you Tess’s confirmed time and repair list as soon as I get them, so you can update Dane and the small-appliance crews without guessing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Tess—just checking I’ve got it straight: the repair drive is this weekend, and Faye needs to know who’s free around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s right, Oren—Saturday morning for the repair drive, and yes, tell Faye we’re trying to pin down who can help around school drop-off and pickup so no one’s stretched too thin.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess—Saturday morning, repair drive, and I’ll ask who’s free around drop-off and pickup before I report back to Faye.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rey—I'm checking with the group today to confirm who's coordinating the tool list and sign-ups before we promise any repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Mara—Mina’s steering the priorities, and I’m gathering the volunteer names one-on-one; Cleo’s keeping the spare parts and tools separate for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that helps. I’ll note Mina on priorities, you on volunteer names, and Cleo on parts and tools, then I’ll still confirm the Saturday start time before telling Noah or Bo specifics.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Nell, I’ve got the repair drive marked for Sunday at the community center, with tool needs sorted for screwdrivers and pliers and volunteer slots around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — that’s more detail than I had, but I’d better hold off sharing it since Rosa was still confirming the time and place, and I’d heard Saturday only tentatively.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good catch, Nell—I’ll mark Sunday at the community center as unconfirmed for now and check back with Rosa and Faye before anyone shares it.
